overall.counted_text: Counted: 1 side of a bet between two coaches and 6 read out of the coaches' running commentary.

skill.sentence: Too few checked calls yet (7) to compare them with a simple guess.

comparison.rule_sentence: Number calls: on the 3 a guess could also be checked against, the coaches were right once and a guess that nothing changes 2 times — the guess was right more often, on too few calls to tell. Direction calls: on the 3 a guess could also be checked against, the coaches were right 0 times and a guess that nothing changes 2 times — the guess was right more often, on too few calls to tell. Yes/no bets: on the 1 a guess could also be checked against, the coaches were right 0 times and a guess that nothing changes 0 times — level, on too few calls to tell.

comparison.method: Each graded call is also scored by a rule that predicts nothing changes — the metric stays at its last reading before the day the call was filed — graded by the same grader against the same tolerance. Number calls, direction calls, yes/no bets and sealed day-one predictions are separate records and are never added together. 'Did better' is a two-sided exact sign test (p < 0.05) on the calls only one of the two got right; calls that share a metric and a window are not independent, so it is optimistic. No percentage or verdict below 20 scored calls.
